title.narrative: Program to Support Policy Reform in Water Resources and Solid Waste
Programa de Apoyo a Reforma de Polticas en Recursos Hdricos y Residuos Slidos

description.narrative: The general objective of the Program is to contribute to water security and environmental sustainability in Uruguay by strengthening governance and management with a focus on circularity, adaptation and mitigation to Climate Change (CC). The specific objectives are: (i) improve Water Resources (HR) management and the quality of water services by increasing resilience to extreme events; and (ii) strengthen solid waste management with a circular economy approach.
